Broad network access ensures that both Development and Operations can access the code easily B. Resource pooling and rapid elasticity make cloud computing cheaper, so that resources can go to development

Yes, because if extensive automaton is not used, technical debt will start accumulating D. Yes, because the deployment pipeline is needed for continuous automation activities E.
